name: B10-0519/2025 (S&D) – Escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate end to the war in Sudan. It condemns atrocities by the Rapid Support Forces and violations by both sides. It asks the EU to push for humanitarian access, protect civilians, investigate and punish those responsible, and support a civilian transition to democracy. It also urges sanctions, including on outside backers of the fighters, and a halt to EU trade talks with the United Arab Emirates until that country stops supporting the Rapid Support Forces.

- The EU is asked to sanction backers, ban conflict minerals and pause UAE trade talks.
- It affects Sudan's warring sides, their foreign backers, and civilians needing aid.
- Next: EU bodies decide whether to act on these requests.
